**`lib/response.js`** (these call it as `this.set(...)`):
- `res.links`, line 94: sets `Link`
- `res.send`, lines 175, 199, 206 and 223: sets `Content-Type`, `Content-Length` and `ETag`
- `res.json`, line 276: sets `Content-Type`
- `res.jsonp`, lines 320–332: sets `X-Content-Type-Options` and `Content-Type`
- `res.type` / `res.contentType`, line 625: one function with two names; I list it as `res.contentType`, which is its declared name (`function contentType`)
- `res.format`, line 699: sets `Content-Type`
- `res.attachment`, line 725: sets `Content-Disposition`
- `res.append`, line 756
- `res.location`, line 924: sets `Location`
- `res.redirect`, line 982: sets `Content-Length`

**`lib/router/index.js`**:
- `sendOptionsResponse`, line 654: `res.set('Allow', body)`

The call at `response.js:798` is inside `res.set` itself, so it is left out. Nothing in `lib/` calls `res.header(...)` by that name; it only appears in comments.
